title: Healing Tender Tamil Lamb Curry
description: A briny, tender rogan josh style curry with lamb shanks, shio-cured and slow-cooked to a post-workout delight, featuring coconut and yogurt for creamy richness.
instructions: Pat dry lamb shanks and rub with 10 g salt, 5 g pepper, and a pinch of cumin seeds, then let cure at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Heat a tablespoon of oil in the Lazy Susan Spinner and brown the lamb shanks on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Add minced ginger and garlic to the pot and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir in 10 g coriander powder, 5 g garam masala, and a splash of coconut milk, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in 240 ml tomato puree, then return the lamb shanks to the pot, coating them in the sauce.
Add 200 ml coconut milk, cover the Lazy Susan Spinner, and set the heat to low for 90 minutes, rotating the pot every 15 minutes.
After 90 minutes, stir in 100 g plain yogurt, simmer for another 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Remove the lid, sprinkle with fresh coriander leaves, and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Transfer the curry to a serving dish and drizzle a little lemon juice for brightness.
Serve hot with steamed rice or warm naan.
